title: submission

type.description: one of duplicate_invoice, payment_allocation, fx_conversion, period_cutoff; any other string matches no issue (false positive)

claimed_amount_minor.description: minor units of `currency`; the reference amount is a non-negative magnitude

currency.description: compared exactly with the reference currency code, no case folding or trimming

evidence_ids.description: a finding citing an id that is not in the open data matches no issue

description: Argument of submit (findings.json). A wrong JSON type, a missing or extra field, or a list or text over its limit ends the episode with reward -1. A structurally valid finding with a wrong value (type, ids, amount, currency, evidence) is a false positive.
